Summary of audience, acquisition, engagement, and conversion behavior using Google Analytics reporting tools. Coursework focused on interpreting traffic patterns, identifying acquisition channels, and translating metrics into actionable business recommendations.

Measurement plan connecting marketing goals to KPIs, traffic sources, event tracking, and reporting cadence. Developed frameworks for evaluating campaign performance and ROI across digital channels.

<span class="tag">Campaign Measurement</span>
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Analytics Insight Summaries

Short-form analysis translating data patterns into recommendations for marketing or website performance improvement. Practiced summarizing complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

<span class="tag">Recommendations</span>

## Data Science in R

In addition to analytics tools like Google Analytics, I have applied R and the Tidyverse ecosystem for statistical analysis and data visualization. Key coursework pages on this site include:

- [Data Visualization in R](data-viz.qmd) — ggplot2, plotly, correlation analysis, and interactive charts
- [Data Wrangling with Tidyverse](data-wrangling.qmd) — Reshaping, cleaning, and transforming datasets
- [Advanced Data Visualization](advanced-viz.qmd) — Scales, composition, annotation, and design principles
- [R Programming](r-programming.qmd) — Custom functions, apply/map patterns, and functional programming
